sections.title: Energy (Dominion Energy)
sections.description: Dominion Energy (Richmond HQ) is one of the US's largest regulated utilities — serving 7 million electricity customers.

blocks.heading: Grid reliability ML
paragraphs: Outage prediction and equipment failure forecasting for Dominion's large transmission and distribution network in Virginia — incorporating weather, equipment age, vegetation management data, and the specific geography of Dominion's coastal Virginia service territory where hurricane and nor'easter events create significant outage events.

blocks.heading: Offshore wind operations AI
paragraphs: ML for Dominion's large offshore wind investment — the Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind project (2.6 GW under development) creates generation forecasting, marine operations scheduling, and turbine performance analytics demand.

blocks.heading: Customer analytics
paragraphs: Energy efficiency program targeting, EV adoption forecasting, and rate plan recommendation for Dominion's large residential and commercial customer base.

sections.title: Financial Services

blocks.heading: Markel specialty insurance AI

sections.title: Richmond's emerging technology ecosystem

blocks.heading: CarMax's technology transformation
paragraphs: CarMax has invested significantly in technology — the company's digital retail capabilities (online vehicle purchasing, virtual appraisal) represent one of the US's most ambitious automotive retail technology programs. CarMax's analytics and data science organization has grown substantially and has become one of Richmond's largest technology employers outside of Dominion Energy.

blocks.heading: Capital One's Richmond presence
paragraphs: Capital One's McLean VA headquarters is in Northern Virginia, but Capital One has significant Richmond-area operations and technology investment that shapes the regional technology labor market. Capital One's ML engineering culture — the company was an early mover in cloud adoption and ML in financial services — has influenced Richmond's broader technology community.

blocks.heading: Virginia's tech-forward government
paragraphs: Virginia's state government has been consistently ranked among the US's most technology-forward state administrations. The Commonwealth's IT investment, including AI adoption programs and the Commonwealth Enterprise Solutions Center, creates government technology AI demand in Richmond that exceeds most state capitals.
